snippet.title: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4927490/Cleaning_Up_The_Puzzle_Gallery

Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery is a cozy first-person organization simulator about cleaning up 2071 puzzle pieces scattered across a gallery of 87 famous paintings. Whether you want to relax and solve jigsaw puzzles to classical music, or min-max to get the fastest times, the gallery needs cleaning.

Developed by
Th3GameStudio
